<infobox theme="Battle350">
        <data source="prev"><label>Previous</label></data>	
        <data source="conc"><label>Concurrent</label></data>	
        <data source="next"><label>Next</label></data>	
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header></header>
        <data source="conflict"><label>Conflict</label></data>
        <data source="date"><label>Date</label></data>
        <data source="place"><label>Place</label></data>	
        <data source="result"><label>Outcome</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group layout="horizontal" show="incomplete" collapse="open">
    	<header>Combatants</header>
        <data source="side1"></data>	
        <data source="side2"></data>
        <data source="side3"></data>	
    </group>
    <group layout="horizontal" show="incomplete" collapse="open">
    	<header>Strength</header>
        <data source="forces1"></data>	
        <data source="forces2"></data>
        <data source="forces3"></data>	
    </group>
    <group layout="horizontal" show="incomplete" collapse="open">
    	<header>Casualties</header>
        <data source="casual1"></data>	
        <data source="casual2"></data>
        <data source="casual3"></data>	
    </group>
    <group layout="horizontal" show="incomplete" collapse="open">
        <header>Civilian casualties</header>
        <data source="civilian"></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Duel|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox><noinclude>
